info.title: Synapse Gateway API
info.description: Agent-first USDC settlement API for service discovery, paid invocation, budget isolation, provider onboarding, and withdrawal evidence.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Wallet challenge, signature verification, and session lifecycle.

tags.name: Balance
tags.description: Account balances, deposits, and spending-limit queries.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: Service registration, discovery, listing, updates, and deletion.

tags.name: Provider Operations
tags.description: Provider secrets, earnings, withdrawal tickets, and runtime health evidence.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: Issue, list, and revoke agent credentials.

tags.name: Community
tags.description: Feedback and forum APIs for docs issues, product bugs, questions, replies, and resolved discussions.

get.description:
Returns a one-time nonce string for the given wallet address. Sign it with the owner private key and submit to /verify.

Agent policy: Step 1 of owner auth. Call with the owner wallet address to receive a time-limited nonce. Sign it immediately with ECDSA (EIP-191) and pass to POST /auth/verify.

400.description: MISSING_ADDRESS: address query param is required

422.description: INVALID_ADDRESS: Not a valid 0x wallet address

post.description:
Submit the EIP-191 signed challenge. Gateway verifies the signature and returns a 24-hour JWT.

Agent policy: Step 2 of owner auth. Submit the signed challenge. On success the gateway returns a 24-hour JWT. Store it — all owner-side calls require it as the Bearer token.

401.description: VERIFICATION_FAILED: Signature does not match wallet address

example.message: Signature does not match wallet address

422.description: CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: Challenge expired — request a new one

example.message: Challenge expired — request a new one

get.description:
Returns the wallet-linked account profile: display name, email, and notification preferences.

Agent policy: Confirm authenticated identity. Use after auth to verify the JWT is valid and which wallet it is bound to.

post.description:
Generates a one-time signing challenge for updating the account profile (name, email, preferences).

Agent policy: Step 1 of a profile update. Generates a challenge that proves the owner wallet authorises the change. Required before PUT /auth/me/profile.

example.challenge: Synapse profile update nonce: def456 | ts: 1711234600
Synapse profile update nonce: def456 | ts: 1711234600

put.description:
Submit wallet-signed proof to update account name, notification preferences, and email binding intent. New or changed email addresses are staged as pendingEmail until a verification code is confirmed. Submitting the current verified email cancels a pending change; submitting null removes the verified email.

Agent policy: Step 2 of profile update. Submits the signed challenge alongside new profile fields. Wallet signature prevents unauthorised profile changes.

example.message: Synapse profile update nonce: def456 | ts: 1711234600
Synapse profile update nonce: def456 | ts: 1711234600

post.description:
Confirms the 6-digit code sent to a pending email address. Only after this succeeds does Gateway bind the email to the wallet account.

Agent policy: Step 3 of email binding. Submit the code from the verification email. Codes expire after 10 minutes and lock after 5 bad attempts.

400.description: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The code expired; request a new one

example.message: The code expired; request a new one

post.description:
Generates a fresh 6-digit verification code for the current pending email. Each wallet can send at most 5 verification emails per UTC day.

Agent policy: Use when a user did not receive the current code. Resending invalidates the old code.

429.description: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: Daily email verification limit reached

post.description:
Invalidates the current session token server-side.

Agent policy: Invalidate the JWT when the session ends. After this call the token cannot be used for any further requests.

get.description:
Returns the complete balance breakdown: consumer available (spendable by agents), provider receivable (earned, unsettled), and protocol fee totals.

Agent policy: Check spendable balance before issuing agent credentials. consumer_available_balance is the USDC an agent can spend. If zero the owner must deposit USDC first.

post.description:
After completing the onchain SynapseCore.deposit() transaction, register the txHash to initiate balance indexing.

Agent policy: Call after the onchain USDC deposit is confirmed. The gateway indexes the event and credits consumer_available_balance.

409.description: DUPLICATE_TX_HASH: This transaction hash has already been registered

example.message: This transaction hash has already been registered

get.description:
Returns the current velocity-limit policy for the owner account (daily, per-call).

Agent policy: Returns the configured spending velocity limits. Agent credential credit_limit must not exceed these limits.

Returns the marketplace of active, healthy services available for invocation. Supports text search and pagination.

Agent policy: First step for a consumer agent: scan the marketplace for available APIs or LLM services. Fixed-price APIs return pricing.amount; LLM services return token-metered fields.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: Free-text search over service names and descriptions

get.description:
Returns a paginated, machine-readable registry of services that are currently callable from the public marketplace. Use this when an agent needs to enumerate registered services before choosing a serviceId.

Agent policy: Public machine-readable marketplace feed. It only returns callable services, so agents can page through the registry before selecting a serviceId and invoking through the gateway.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page. Defaults to 10 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over service names, summaries, endpoints, roles, and tags

services.summary: Extract line items and totals from invoices.
Extract line items and totals from invoices.

post.description:
Provider registers an API service on the Synapse marketplace. The gateway proxies incoming invocations to invoke.targets.

Agent policy: Provider publishes their API as a paid service. The gateway proxies calls to invoke.targets and handles payment automatically.

422.description: INVALID_MANIFEST: Missing required fields: serviceName, invoke.targets

example.summary: Analyze text sentiment via ML model
Analyze text sentiment via ML model

get.description:
Returns all services registered by the authenticated provider wallet.

Agent policy: List all services the authenticated provider has registered. Use to audit active services or get serviceIds for updates.

put.description:
Update any service field including isActive. To delete a service, first set isActive: false, then call DELETE.

Agent policy: Update service config. Critical: to delete a service, first PUT {isActive: false} to deactivate it, then call DELETE. Deleting an active service returns 409.

404.description: SERVICE_NOT_FOUND: No service with this ID owned by caller

example.message: No service with this ID owned by caller

delete.description:
Permanently archives a service. The service MUST be inactive (isActive: false) before deletion.

Agent policy: Soft-archives a service. Guard: service MUST be deactivated (via PUT {isActive: false}) first, or this returns 409 SERVICE_DELETE_ACTIVE_CONFLICT.

404.description: SERVICE_NOT_FOUND: No service with this ID owned by caller

example.message: No service with this ID owned by caller

409.description: SERVICE_DELETE_ACTIVE_CONFLICT: Service is still active — deactivate with PUT {isActive: false} first

example.message: Service is still active — deactivate with PUT {isActive: false} first

get.description:
Returns recent provider health probe history for a service owned by the authenticated provider wallet.

Agent policy: Provider-owned health drilldown. Use it to understand why a service is or is not currently callable.

Returns active provider secret keys owned by the authenticated provider wallet. The raw secret is never returned after issuance.

Agent policy: Provider control-plane inventory for provider secrets. Use owner/provider JWT, not a consumer agent credential.

post.description:
Issues a provider secret for provider-side automation. The secretKey is returned exactly once and must be stored securely by the provider.

Agent policy: Provider onboarding step for controlled provider-side automation. This is not a consumer agent spending credential.

delete.description:
Revokes a provider secret owned by the authenticated provider wallet.

Agent policy: Emergency rotation path for provider automation secrets.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: Secret does not belong to current wallet

example.message: Secret does not belong to current wallet

get.description:
Returns provider earnings analytics and recent settlement context for the authenticated provider wallet.

Agent policy: Provider revenue read model. Use it to confirm that paid traffic is producing receivables before withdrawal.

Reports whether the gateway can currently issue EIP-712 provider withdrawal tickets.

Agent policy: Call before enabling a provider withdrawal button. If ticket signing is unavailable, do not let the user start a withdrawal.

post.description:
Locks provider receivables and creates a provider withdrawal ticket or manual-review request. Amounts must be strings at the API boundary.

Agent policy: Provider self-service withdrawal. It never spends consumer balances; it only reserves provider receivable funds.

402.description: INSUFFICIENT_PROVIDER_RECEIVABLE: Provider receivable balance is too low

example.message: Provider receivable balance is too low

get.description:
Returns provider withdrawal intents and their lifecycle statuses.

Agent policy: Provider audit view for withdrawal intents. Stale active tickets may be lazily cancelled and released when this endpoint is read.

post.description:
Closes a provider withdrawal intent after the provider's onchain withdraw transaction succeeds.

Agent policy: Finalizes the provider withdrawal after chain success. Replays are rejected or idempotently resolved by txHash binding.

400.description: INVALID_TX_HASH: txHash must be a valid 32-byte hex string

example.message: txHash must be a valid 32-byte hex string

404.description: WITHDRAWAL_NOT_FOUND: Provider withdrawal intent not found

409.description: TX_HASH_REPLAY: txHash is already bound to another withdrawal

example.message: txHash is already bound to another withdrawal

post.description:
Invoke a service in one HTTP call. For fixed-price APIs, pass costUsdc — the price the agent saw in discovery. For serviceKind=llm / priceModel=token_metered, omit costUsdc and optionally pass maxCostUsdc; Gateway pre-authorizes, captures final Provider usage, and releases the rest.

Agent policy: Preferred invoke path. Fixed APIs use costUsdc price assertion. LLM services use token-metered pre-authorization and final usage billing.

400.description: LLM_AUTO_HOLD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Automatic hold exceeds service cap; pass maxCostUsdc explicitly

example.message: Automatic hold exceeds service cap; pass maxCostUsdc explicitly

402.description: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Credential budget does not allow this invocation

example.message: Credential budget does not allow this invocation

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Idempotency key reused with different payload

example.message: Idempotency key reused with different payload

422.description: PRICE_MISMATCH: Service price changed since discovery — re-discover and retry

example.message: Service price changed since discovery — re-discover and retry

502.description: UPSTREAM_ERROR: Provider service returned an error

get.description:
Fetch the settlement receipt for a specific invocation.

Agent policy: Retrieve the settlement receipt for any past invocation. Use to verify completion, audit charges, or retrieve the result if the original response was lost.

404.description: INVOCATION_NOT_FOUND: No invocation found with this ID

example.message: No invocation found with this ID

get.description:
Owner-level audit log of all invocations under this wallet. Paginated.

Agent policy: Owner-level audit view of all invocations under this wallet. Use to reconcile charges, monitor agent activity, and verify settlement amounts.

post.description:
Mint a new spend-limited agent credential. The returned token is used by the agent runtime for all /agent/* calls.

Agent policy: Owner mints a spend-limited token for an autonomous agent. maxCalls and creditLimit prevent runaway spending. Pass the token to the agent — never expose the owner JWT to the agent.

402.description: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Owner has no spendable balance — deposit USDC first

example.message: Owner has no spendable balance — deposit USDC first

422.description: LIMIT_EXCEEDED: credit_limit exceeds owner spending policy

get.description:
Returns all active agent credentials issued by the authenticated owner.

Agent policy: Audit which agent tokens are active and how many calls each has consumed. Identify credentials approaching limits.

post.description:
Immediately invalidates an agent credential. Any subsequent call using this token is rejected.

Agent policy: Emergency shutoff: revoke a compromised or over-limit agent token immediately. Takes effect server-side instantly.

403.description: NOT_OWNER: Only the issuing owner can revoke this credential

example.message: Only the issuing owner can revoke this credential

404.description: CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND: No credential with this ID

post.description:
Creates a redacted feedback report from docs or dashboard surfaces. Actionable support categories also create an Admin Forum Support task.

Agent policy: Use this for low-friction docs or product feedback. If a wallet JWT is present, the gateway binds the report to that wallet.

422.description: INVALID_PAYLOAD: source, sentiment, or message is invalid

example.message: source, sentiment, or message is invalid

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: Too many feedback reports in this window

example.message: Too many feedback reports in this window

get.description:
Returns public forum topics with category, search, sort, and pagination filters.

Agent policy: Public community search for known issues, provider service discussions, and SDK questions.

post.description:
Creates a forum topic. Requires wallet JWT, filters secrets, and emits a forum_topic_created event.

Agent policy: Use for logged-in community posts. Do not include JWTs, provider secrets, private keys, or authorization headers.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: Too many topics in this window

get.description:
Returns a topic body and visible replies.

Agent policy: Use to inspect a known issue or support discussion.

post.description:
Adds a reply to an unlocked topic. Requires wallet JWT and redacts sensitive content.

Agent policy: Use for follow-up, workarounds, and support references.

Marks an authored topic as resolved.

Agent policy: Topic authors can mark their own question or bug as resolved.
